text: The master's program of this major actively docks with the national and Zhejiang Provincial development strategies, and is positioned to cultivate application-oriented compound high-level financial talents under the background of the national-level Wenzhou Financial Comprehensive Reform Pilot Zone. This master's program insists on cultivating people with virtue, and the students cultivated should have the following abilities and qualities: 1. Have a solid theoretical foundation in economics and finance, good professional ethics, innovative and enterprising spirit, and strong ability to engage in financial practical work application-oriented compound high-level financial talents. 2. Master the basic principles of Marxism and the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics, develop morally, intellectually, physically and aesthetically in an all-round way, and have good professional ethics, professional quality and comprehensive quality. 3. Have a solid theoretical foundation and skills in finance, have a forward-looking and international vision, and be able to apply relevant theories and methods of finance to solve practical problems.
